summary: An 8-crate Rust workspace (`pod-core`, `telemetry-graph`, `physics-logic`, `incident-audit`, `sensor-integrity`, `privacy`, `settlement`, `pod-cli`) for autonomous vehicle Proof-of-Damage insurance claims. Needs rigid-body momentum/impulse conservation checks in `physics-logic`, cryptographic sensor taint propagation in `sensor-integrity`, and non-malleable zk-witness commitments in `privacy` and `settlement`.

tasks.title: Enforce impulse-momentum and kinetic energy consistency invariants in physics-logic
tasks.spec:
Strengthen `crates/physics-logic/src/conditions.rs` and `solver.rs` with cross-modal physical conservation invariants.

1. Compute integrated IMU velocity change $\Delta v_{\text{imu}} = \int_{t_0}^{t_1} a(t)\,dt$ and compare against wheel-odometry velocity delta $\Delta v_{\text{odom}}$ (allowing bounded tire-slip tolerance during ABS activation).
2. Compute Specific Energy Absorption (SEA) crush consistency: verify that structural deformation depth $\delta_{\text{crush}}$ satisfies $\frac{1}{2} m (\Delta v)^2 \approx \int_0^{\delta_{\text{crush}}} k_{\text{stiffness}}(x) x\,dx$ within $\pm 25\%$ structural tolerance.
3. Add unit tests rejecting synthetic insurance fraud traces where an attacker injects a fake $15g$ IMU spike while wheel odometry and strain gauges remain flat.

tasks.title: Harden cross-sensor clock-skew and replay detection in sensor-integrity
tasks.spec:
Enhance `crates/sensor-integrity/src/taint.rs` and `verify.rs`.

1. Detect inter-domain timestamp skew $> 5\text{ ms}$ between IMU, CAN odometry, and airbag control unit (ACU) frames.
2. Enforce strict monotonic sequence numbers and hash-chain linkage in `verify.rs` so spliced or replayed pre-crash buffers are marked `TaintVerdict::Compromised`.
3. Add unit tests for frame splicing, timestamp rollback, and single-channel sensor injection.

tasks.title: Bind incident nullifiers and blinded GPS geofence proofs in privacy and settlement
tasks.spec:
Upgrade `crates/privacy` and `crates/settlement` to prevent double-claiming and location leakage.

1. Compute a deterministic collision nullifier `N = BLAKE3(vehicle_vin_commitment || crash_timestamp_bucket || impulse_vector_hash)` inside `privacy/src/circuit.rs`.
2. Prove that the incident occurred within a valid policy jurisdiction bounding box without revealing exact GPS coordinates in the public proof transcript.
3. In `settlement/src/client.rs`, reject any payout request whose nullifier has already been settled or whose sensor-integrity taint flag is non-clean.
4. Add integration tests verifying double-claim rejection and valid atomic payout settlement.
